symptom: http://127.0.0.1:5173/launcher was temporarily unreachable during a large frontend source split

vite_error: Failed to load url /src/app/App.js from src/main.tsx
Failed to load url /src/lib/queryClient.js from src/main.tsx

root_cause: Vite observed a non-atomic intermediate state while frontend JavaScript artifacts and imports were being replaced during a large source split. The pre-transform failure made the dev frontend temporarily unavailable; Instance Supervisor then restarted Vite after the tree stabilized.
resolution: Instance Supervisor recovered the main frontend; live HTTP, API, WebSocket, and Chromium rendering were revalidated without restarting the main instance.
prevention: Keep main backend reload disabled during multi-agent work.
Apply multi-file frontend splits as an atomic edit window when possible and run the frontend typecheck before considering the refactor stable.
Treat Vite pre-transform errors as frontend availability failures and preserve Supervisor recovery telemetry.
Do not restart or kill the main instance when 5173 already returns 200 and a real browser renders Launcher successfully.
